top.previewFirstHelp: Off: clicking a slide puts it on screen straight away. On: clicks load Preview, and Go live (Space) sends it.

addHelp.presentation: Your own slides: text, shapes and pictures.
addHelp.countdown: Counts down to the start, full screen.

library.title: Library
library.noHymnals: No hymnal installed. Add one in Settings → Bibles & hymnals → Install package.

bible.hint: Click a verse to preview. Shift-click to select a range. Double-click to show it now.

slides.transposeHint: Key of the chords on the stage display

quick.placeholder: Type a verse (jn 3 16), hymn number (#23), song title or words…

song.title: Title
song.lyricsHelp: Use [Verse 1], [Chorus], [Bridge] headers. A blank line forces a new slide. Chords go in brackets inside a line, like [G]Amazing [D]grace: only the stage display shows them.
song.arrangementHelp: e.g. V1 C V2 C B C. Leave empty to use sections in order.
song.readOnly: Hymnal songs are read-only. Duplicate it to make your own version.
song.defaultArrangementHint: The default arrangement is used unless an item picks another
song.translationHelp: Same [Section] headings as the lyrics. Pick the translation for an item in the slide grid.

theme.title: Edit theme
theme.name: Name
theme.bgNoneHelp: Keep whatever background is already live

outputs.title: Outputs
outputs.help: Choose what each screen shows. Assignments are remembered — a projector is re-mapped automatically when it is plugged back in.
outputs.windowModeHelp: Show outputs as normal windows on this screen. Use for single-laptop rehearsal or as an OBS window capture.
outputs.warnControl: This is the screen you are working on. Showing an output here will cover the operator window.

roleHelp.main: Lyrics, scripture and media for the room
roleHelp.stage: Current/next slide, clock and notes for the speaker
roleHelp.secondary: A copy of the output, e.g. lobby TV

outputs.noneHelp: Nothing you put live will be visible. Choose a screen in Outputs, or turn on window mode.
outputs.noneToast: Nothing is showing on any screen: no output is set. Open Outputs to pick a projector, or turn on Rehearsal / window mode.

settings.title: Settings
settings.liveEditingHelp: When on, clicking a slide of that kind sends it straight to the screen instead of to Preview. Many churches turn this on for lyrics.
settings.privacyText: Lampstand works fully offline and sends no telemetry. Audio for speech detection (coming soon) is processed on this computer only.

pagesHelp.general: How Lampstand looks on this computer.
pagesHelp.scripture: How Bible passages are split and shown on screen.
pagesHelp.songs: How lyrics are split into slides, and your church licence details.
pagesHelp.presenting: What the screen shows when nothing is live, and how clicks behave while you run a service.
pagesHelp.library: Your songs, services, themes and media live in one library folder. Keep it safe and move it between computers.
pagesHelp.about: What Lampstand does with your data, and which version you are running.
pagesHelp.features: Everything Lampstand does today, and what is coming.
pagesHelp.connections: Run Lampstand from other devices and software, and connect it to the services your church uses. All of this is on the way.

settings.uiThemeHelp: Dark is easiest on the eyes in a dim booth.
settings.uiScaleHelp: Make the whole interface larger or smaller.
settings.defaultVersionHelp: Used by the quick bar and the Bible browser.
settings.slidesFootnote: Text is always sized to fit the screen; these settings decide how much goes on each slide.
settings.versesPerSlideHelp: "Fit" fills each slide; "One verse" gives every verse its own slide.
settings.maxCharsHelp: Longer passages are split at sentence boundaries — never mid-word.
settings.maxLinesHelp: Sections longer than this are split evenly across slides.
settings.ccliHelp: Shown in the song credit on the first slide of songs that have a CCLI number.

liveKindHelp.song: Lyric slides go live when clicked.
liveKindHelp.presentation: Text slides go live when clicked.

settings.backupHelp: Save a snapshot of your songs, services and themes right now.
settings.backupsFootnote: Lampstand also backs up automatically once a day and keeps the last 14 days.
settings.exportHelp: Everything, including media, in a single .zip file.
settings.importHelp: Merge an exported library into this one. A backup is taken first.

offAir.title: Off-air screen
offAir.footnote: Shown on the projector whenever nothing is live: before the service, between items, and after Turn off live. "Logo" uses the logo above. Black screen (B) still goes fully black.
offAir.showHelp: Instead of leaving the screen empty.

picture.label: Picture
picture.help: Any image or video from your Media library. Videos loop silently.
picture.none: Add an image or video in the Media library first.

logo.title: Logo
logo.footnote: Shown when you press Logo (L), and as the off-air screen when that is set to Logo.
logo.showHelp: Your church's name, or your own logo image or video.
logo.name: Church name
logo.nameHelp: Shown large in the middle of the screen.
logo.taglineHelp: Optional smaller line under the name.
logo.lookHelp: The moving background and lettering of the name card.

notice.quarantined: A damaged file ({{file}}) was moved to quarantine and skipped.
notice.newDisplay: New display connected: {{label}}. Assign it in Outputs.
notice.loadFailed: Lampstand could not load your library. Try restarting the app; if it keeps happening, check the logs.

modules.help: Add Bible versions (.lsbible) and hymnals (.lshymnal or .json) from files. Packages are checked and validated before they are installed.
modules.confirmRemove: Remove {{name}}? Service items that use it will show nothing until it is installed again.

empty.hymnal: No hymnals installed yet. Install a .lshymnal or .json package to add one.

inspector.name: Name
inspector.advanceHelp: While live, announcements move to the next slide automatically and loop.
inspector.title: Heading
inspector.notesHelp: Shown on the stage display only.
inspector.liveHint: This slide is live. Changes appear on screen the next time it goes live.
inspector.lastSlide: An item needs at least one slide.
inspector.noSlide: This item has no slides yet.
inspector.minutesHelp: The countdown starts when it goes live.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.action: That action did not work. Please try again.
errors.saveService: Could not save the service. Your changes are still on screen — try again.

guide.intro: Everything you need to run your first service, in order. Steps tick themselves off as you go.

screens.title: Connect your screens
screens.body: Open Outputs and set your projector or TV to Main output. Only have a laptop? Turn on Rehearsal / window mode to see the output in a small window.

packages.title: Add Bibles and hymnals
packages.body: The King James Version is included. Install other Bible versions (.lsbible) and hymnals (.lshymnal) from files you have been given.

service.title: Build your service
service.body: Pick songs from the Library on the left, verses in the Bible workspace, and media from the bin at the bottom. Double-click (or drag) to put them in the service plan. Drag items to reorder, and use Section to group them.

live.title: Click to go live
live.body: Click a slide and it's on the screen (red). Use {{previous}} / {{next}} to step through slides. Prefer a safety step? Turn on Preview first in the toolbar: clicks go to Preview (green) and {{goLive}} sends them.

control.title: Stay in control
control.body: {{clearContent}} clears the text but keeps the background; {{black}} blacks out the screen; {{panic}} is the panic button that clears everything except the background.

backup.title: Keep your library safe
backup.body: Lampstand backs up daily on its own. Use Export to move your songs, services and media to another computer.

guide.quickBarHelp: Press {{key}} and type a verse, a hymn number or words from a song. Enter shows it (or previews it with Preview first on); Shift+Enter always shows it now.
guide.keysHelp: Shortcuts can be changed under Keyboard shortcuts in the toolbar.

preview.title: Green
preview.body: Preview — ready, not on screen yet.

live.title: Red
live.body: Live — this is on the screen right now.

accent.title: Gold
accent.body: Selected or editable — never affects the screen.

modes.label: Workspace
modes.pickItem: Pick something from the library or the service plan
modes.addToEdit: Add this to the service plan to edit it
modes.nothingToEdit: This item has no text to edit
modes.scriptureEditHint: To change the passage, pick verses in the Bible workspace.

messages.name: Name
messages.templatePlaceholder: Parent of {number}, please come to the nursery

timers.name: Name
timers.stageHint: Started timers show on the stage display, and turn red when a countdown runs over.

reflow.label: All slide text
reflow.help: Blank lines split slides. A line like [Verse 1] or [Welcome] starts a new group or slide title.
reflow.unavailable: Reflow works with songs and text slides
reflow.unavailableHelp: Pick a song, or a text slides or announcements item in the service plan.

features.intro: {{available}} features ready to use today, {{soon}} more on the way.

canvas.label: Slide canvas
canvas.hint: Drag to move, corners to resize. Alt: no snapping. Arrows nudge.

import.empty: Nothing to import in that file.

import.pdfStarted: Importing the PDF, one picture per page…

web.title: Web page

web.help: Shown full screen in a separate, locked-down window on the projector. It can't see or change anything in Lampstand.
